dict.string: DeskLife reads whether a selected calendar is busy right now, on this Mac only, to hold reminders during likely calls. Only busy-or-free plus the current busy time's end is used; event names, guest lists, locations, and other details are never kept.

DeskLife finds your paired iPhone on the local network to keep a break timer running when you step away from the Mac. Only break-timer session bytes move between your two paired devices; nothing is sent to a server, and unpaired devices are ignored.
